about: Home and car: renting, buying, mortgages, repairs and moving.

set.do: rentMul = m; rentUntil = age + 7; happy += h; T('move', { kind: 'custom', label: M(lk), note: M('note.move') })

en..x: Renting a place of your own costs about {r} a year. You'll live with this choice for the next few years.
en..alone: Rent a place on your own
en..alone.s: About {r} a year. Your own space. Happiness +4.
en..share.s: About {r} a year for your room. Happiness +1.
en..home.s: About {r} a year towards the bills. Less freedom. Happiness −4.
en.note.move: Rent saved compared with living alone

zh..x: 自己租一个地方，每年大约{r}。接下来几年都要跟着这个决定过。
zh..alone.s: 每年约{r}。有自己的空间。幸福感 +4。
zh..share.s: 你那间房每年约{r}。幸福感 +1。
zh..home.s: 每年给家里约{r}贴补开销。没那么自由。幸福感 −4。
zh.note.move: 跟自己租房相比省下的房租

zht..x: 自己租一個地方，每年大約{r}。接下來幾年都要跟著這個決定過。
zht..alone.s: 每年約{r}。有自己的空間。幸福感 +4。
zht..share.s: 你那間房每年約{r}。幸福感 +1。
zht..home.s: 每年給家裡約{r}貼補開銷。沒那麼自由。幸福感 −4。
zht.note.move: 跟自己租房相比省下的房租

opts.do: car = { type: 'new', bal: 1.1 * B, pay: carPay(1.1 * B) }; happy += 4; T('car', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.carNew') })
car = { type: 'used', bal: 0, pay: 0 }; pay(.35 * B); const t = T('car', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.carUsed') }); t.spent += .35 * B; t.g += .35 * B

en..x: Getting to work is a hassle, and everyone you know is buying a car.
en..new.s: A {c} car. Payments of {p} a year. Happiness +4.

zh..x: 上班通勤很麻烦，身边的人都在买车。
zh..new.s: 一辆{c}的车。每年还款{p}。幸福感 +4。
zh..used.s: 一次付清{c}，再加上日常开销。
zh..none.s: 最省钱，只是没那么方便。

zht..x: 上班通勤很麻煩，身邊的人都在買車。
zht..new.s: 一輛{c}的車。每年還款{p}。幸福感 +4。
zht..used.s: 一次付清{c}，再加上日常開銷。
zht..none.s: 最省錢，只是沒那麼方便。

opts.ok: liq >= .23 * P || M('.need', { n: MN(.23 * P), h: MN(liq) })

en..x: A typical family home costs {p}. Banks want 20% down, plus 3% in fees.
en..buy.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 30 years. No more rent.
en..small.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year. Saves 60% of your rent.
en..rent.s: Rent stays about {r} a year. Your savings stay where they are.

zh..x: 一间普通的家庭住宅要{p}。银行要20%首付，外加3%手续费。
zh..buy.s: 首付加费用共{d}，之后30年每年还{m}。不用再付房租。
zh..small.s: 首付加费用共{d}，之后每年还{m}。省下60%的房租。
zh..rent.s: 房租大约每年{r}。你的存款不动。

zht..x: 一間普通的家庭住宅要{p}。銀行要20%頭期款，外加3%手續費。
zht..buy.s: 頭期款加費用共{d}，之後30年每年還{m}。不用再付房租。
zht..small.s: 頭期款加費用共{d}，之後每年還{m}。省下60%的房租。
zht..rent.s: 房租大約每年{r}。你的存款不動。

ride.do: setRate(house, .065, age); T('rates', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.rates'), note: M('note.rates') }); later(age + 2 + Math.floor(roll('rateLen') * 4), 'rate')

opts.do: pay(.01 * house.mort); setRate(house, .05, age); T('rates', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ratesFix'), v: -.01 * house.mort, note: M('note.rates') }); later(age + 5, 'rate')
pay(x); house.mort -= x; house.out += x; ride()

later.rate: const h = house; if (h && h.rate > .03) { setRate(h, .03, age); log(M('log.rateDown'), 'good'); }

en..x: Mortgage rates rise from 3% to 6.5%. Your yearly payment would go from {a} to {b}. Nobody knows how long rates will stay high.
en..fix: Fix your rate at 5% for 5 years
en..fix.s: A fee of {a}. Your payment stays steady.
en..pay: Pay down part of the loan
en..pay.s: Use {a} of your savings. Smaller payments from now on.
en..payNo: Not enough savings to make a difference.
en..ride.s: Pay the higher rate until rates come down again.

zh..x: 房贷利率从3%涨到6.5%。你每年的还款会从{a}变成{b}。没人知道高利率会持续多久。
zh..pay.s: 用掉{a}的存款。以后每期还得少一点。
zh..payNo: 存款不够，提前还也没多大差别。
zh..ride.s: 付高利率，直到利率再降下来。
zh.note.rates: 超过3%的部分多付的利息

zht..x: 房貸利率從3%漲到6.5%。你每年的還款會從{a}變成{b}。沒人知道高利率會持續多久。
zht..pay.s: 用掉{a}的存款。以後每期還得少一點。
zht..payNo: 存款不夠，提前還也沒多大差別。
zht..ride.s: 付高利率，直到利率再降下來。
zht.note.rates: 超過3%的部分多付的利息

events.text: house ? M('.x', { a: MN(house.value) }) : M('.x0', { p: MN(price()) })

opts.do: const h = house, v = h.value; cash += v * .95 - h.mort; const t = trk.home; if (t) t.note = M('note.homeSold', {a: MN(v)}); house = null; T('bubble', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.bubbleSell'), ref: v, note: M('note.bubble0')})

opts.sub: M('e.home.buy.s', {d: MN(.23 * P), m: MN(mPay(.8 * P))})
opts.ok: liq >= .23 * P || M('e.home.need', {n: MN(.23 * P), h: MN(liq)})

later.burst: const down = roll('burst') < .6, m = down ? .7 : 1.15; hm *= m; if (house) house.value *= m; const t = trk.bubble; if (t) { t.v = (1 - m) * t.ref; t.note = M(down ? 'note.bubbleDodge' : 'note.bubbleMiss', { a: MN(Math.abs(t.v)) }); } log(M(down ? 'log.burst' : 'log.boom'), down ? 'bad' : 'good')

en..x: Home prices are up 30% in two years. Your home is now worth {a}. Everyone says prices only go up.
en..x0: Home prices are up 30% in two years. A family home now costs {p}. Everyone says prices only go up.
en..sell.s: About {a} after fees and the loan.
en..hold.s: It's your home. Ride it out.
en.trk.bubbleSell: Sold your home in the boom
en.note.bubble0: Waiting to see where prices go

zh..x: 两年内房价涨了30%。你的房子现在值{a}。人人都说房价只会涨。
zh..x0: 两年内房价涨了30%。一间家庭住宅现在要{p}。人人都说房价只会涨。
zh..sell.s: 扣掉费用和房贷后大约拿到{a}。
zh..hold.s: 这是你的家，熬过去就好。

zht..x: 兩年內房價漲了30%。你的房子現在值{a}。人人都說房價只會漲。
zht..x0: 兩年內房價漲了30%。一間家庭住宅現在要{p}。人人都說房價只會漲。
zht..sell.s: 扣掉費用和房貸後大約拿到{a}。
zht..hold.s: 這是你的家，撐過去就好。

later.roof: if (!house || roll('roof') >= .5) return; const c = .3 * base; pay(c); const t = trk.roof; if (t) { t.spent += c; t.g += c; } log(M('log.roof', { a: MN(c) }), 'bad')

en..x: Your roof has started leaking in heavy rain.
en..patch.h: Half the time, a patched roof fails within a few years and costs far more.

zh..x: 下大雨时，你家屋顶开始漏水。
zh..patch.h: 补过的屋顶有一半会在几年内再坏，到时花得更多。

zht..x: 下大雨時，你家屋頂開始漏水。
zht..patch.h: 補過的屋頂有一半會在幾年內再壞，到時花得更多。

opts.do: const old = car.bal || 0; car = { type: 'new', bal: 1.5 * B + old, pay: carPay(1.5 * B + old), trk: 'car2' }; happy += 4; T('car2', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.car2Lux') })
T('car2', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.car2Keep') }); rec('car2', .07 * base, 8)

en..x: Your car is getting old, and a friend has just bought a luxury car.
en..lux: A luxury car on a loan
en..lux.s: A {c} car, trading in your old one. Payments of {p} a year for 5 years. Happiness +4.
en..sens: A sensible car, paid in cash
en..keep.s: Repairs come to about {a} a year.

zh..x: 你的车越来越旧，朋友刚买了一辆豪车。
zh..lux.s: 一辆{c}的车，旧车折价。5年内每年还{p}。幸福感 +4。

zht..x: 你的車越來越舊，朋友剛買了一輛名車。
zht..lux.s: 一輛{c}的車，舊車折價。5年內每年還{p}。幸福感 +4。

opts.do: T('room', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.room') }); rec('room', -.06 * base, 10); happy -= 2

en..x: Your house has a spare bedroom now.
en..rent.s: About {a} a year. Less privacy. Happiness −2.

zh..x: 你家现在多了一间空卧室。
zh..rent.s: 每年约{a}。少了点隐私。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 你家現在多了一間空臥室。
zht..rent.s: 每年約{a}。少了點隱私。幸福感 −2。

opts.do: const h = house; let x = .45 * h.value; h.value *= .5; h.frac *= .5; h.out += .05 * h.value; const p = Math.min(x, h.mort); h.mort -= p; x -= p; if (h.mort < 1) h.mort = 0; mkLot('down', {}, 'trk.down'); addLot('down', x); happy -= 2

en..x: Your home is worth {a}, and it feels bigger than you need now.
en..sell.s: Frees up about {b} to invest, with lower upkeep. Happiness −2.

zh..x: 你的房子值{a}，现在住起来觉得太大了。
zh..sell.s: 空出大约{b}可以投资，维护费也更低。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 你的房子值{a}，現在住起來覺得太大了。
zht..sell.s: 空出大約{b}可以投資，維護費也更低。幸福感 −2。

opts.label: M('.unlock', { a: MN(.3 * house.value) })
opts.do: const h = house, x = .3 * h.value; cash += x; h.mort += x; h.rate = .05; h.pay = 0; happy += 3; T('reverse', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.reverse'), note: M('note.reverse', { a: MN(x) }) })

en..x: Your home is worth {a} and fully paid off. A bank offers a reverse mortgage: cash now, repaid from the house later.
en..unlock.s: No monthly payments. The loan grows at 5% a year and is repaid when the house is sold. Money for comforts: Happiness +3.
en.note.reverse: Took {a} out. The loan grows each year.

zh..x: 你的房子值{a}，房贷已经还清。银行提议以房养老：现在给你现金，以后从房子里还。
zh..unlock.s: 不用每月还款。贷款每年以5%增长，等房子卖掉时再还清。多了钱过得舒服些：幸福感 +3。
zh.note.reverse: 拿出了{a}，贷款每年都在增长。

zht..x: 你的房子值{a}，房貸已經還清。銀行提議以房養老：現在給你現金，以後從房子裡還。
zht..unlock.s: 不用每月還款。貸款每年以5%增長，等房子賣掉時再還清。多了錢過得舒服些：幸福感 +3。
zht.note.reverse: 拿出了{a}，貸款每年都在增長。

opts.do: T('move2', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.move2') }); rec('move2', .25 * base, 40, 1); happy += 4

en..x: A retirement village nearby has care on hand, meals and neighbours your age. It costs about {a} a year on top of your home costs.
en..move.s: About {a} a year. Company, and help when you need it. Happiness +4.

zh..x: 附近有一个养老社区，有护理人员、三餐，还有同龄的邻居。除了原本的住房开销，每年还要约{a}。
zh..move.s: 每年约{a}。有人作伴，需要时有人帮忙。幸福感 +4。

zht..x: 附近有一個養生村，有照護人員、三餐，還有同齡的鄰居。除了原本的住房開銷，每年還要約{a}。
zht..move.s: 每年約{a}。有人作伴，需要時有人幫忙。幸福感 +4。

en..x: Your course starts in the autumn. Where will you live?
en..halls.s: About {a} more on your student loan.
en..share.s: About {a} more on your student loan.
en..home.h: You miss some of student life.

zh..x: 秋天就要开学了。你要住哪里？

zht..x: 秋天就要開學了。你要住哪裡？

opts.do: rentMul = .8; rentUntil = age + 5; happy -= 2; T('move', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.y_flatD'), note: M('note.move')})

en..x: Your lease is up. A nicer flat with a balcony has come up, and so has a smaller one further out.
en..up.s: About 30% more rent for five years.
en..down.s: About 20% less rent for five years.

zh..x: 租约到期了。有一间带阳台的好房子，也有一间更小更远的。

zht..x: 租約到期了。有一間有陽台的好房子，也有一間更小更遠的。

opts.do: rentMul = .65; rentUntil = age + 4; happy -= 1; T('move', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.y_flatmate'), note: M('note.move')})

en..x: Rent takes a big bite of your pay. A friend of a friend needs a room.
en..yes.s: Your rent falls by about a third.
en..yes.h: Happiness −1. Some flatmates turn out to be trouble.

zh..x: 房租占了工资一大块。朋友的朋友在找房间。
zh..yes.s: 你的房租少大约三分之一。
zh..yes.h: 幸福感 −1。有些室友会惹麻烦。

zht..x: 房租佔了薪水一大塊。朋友的朋友在找房間。
zht..yes.s: 你的房租少大約三分之一。
zht..yes.h: 幸福感 −1。有些室友會惹麻煩。

en..x: Your flatmate moves out overnight, owing {a} in rent and bills.
en..find: Cover it and find someone new
en..alone: Cover it and live alone again
en..alone.s: {a} out of your pocket, and the full rent again.

zh..x: 室友一夜之间搬走，欠了{a}的房租和水电。
zh..alone.s: 自掏腰包{a}，房租也恢复全额。

zht..x: 室友一夜之間搬走，欠了{a}的房租和水電。
zht..alone.s: 自掏腰包{a}，房租也恢復全額。

opts.do: spend('y_depositF', .005 * base, 'trk.y_depositF'); if (roll('y_deposit') < .65) cash += a; happy -= 1

en..x: You move out, and the landlord keeps your {a} deposit for “cleaning and damage”.
en..claim: Take it to a small claims court
en..claim.h: Tenants with photos and receipts usually win.

zh..x: 你搬走了，房东以“清洁和损坏”为由扣下{a}押金。
zh..claim.h: 有照片和收据的房客通常会赢。

zht..x: 你搬走了，房東以「清潔和損壞」為由扣下{a}押金。
zht..claim.h: 有照片和收據的房客通常會贏。

opts.do: rentMul = .15; rentUntil = age + 6; happy -= 3; T('move', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.y_moveback'), note: M('note.move')})

en..x: Your parents say you could move back into your old room to save money for a while.
en..yes.s: You chip in a little for food; no rent.

zh..x: 爸妈说你可以搬回以前的房间，存一阵子钱。
zh..yes.s: 只出一点伙食费，不用房租。

zht..x: 爸媽說你可以搬回以前的房間，存一陣子錢。
zht..yes.s: 只出一點伙食費，不用房租。

en..x: Two years back at home. Your savings look healthy, and your parents are starting to hint.

zh..x: 回家住两年了。存款看起来不错，爸妈也开始暗示了。

zht..x: 回家住兩年了。存款看起來不錯，爸媽也開始暗示了。

en..x: Your new place is empty: no bed, no sofa, no table.
en..credit.h: Happiness +3. Store credit charges high interest.

zh..x: 新住处空荡荡的：没床、没沙发、没桌子。

zht..x: 新住處空蕩蕩的：沒床、沒沙發、沒桌子。
zht..credit.h: 幸福感 +3。分期的利息很高。
zht..used: 跟朋友和網路上買二手

opts.do: T('f_far', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.f_far')}); rec('f_far', .015 * base, 10, -.2); happy += 1

en..x: With children, your rented flat feels tiny.
en..out.s: Same rent, about {a} a year more in travel.
en..out.h: Happiness +1; longer commutes wear you down a little.

zh..x: 有了孩子，租的房子显得好小。
zh..out.s: 房租一样，每年多花大约{a}的交通费。
zh..out.h: 幸福感 +1；通勤变长会有点累。

zht..x: 有了孩子，租的房子顯得好小。
zht..out.s: 房租一樣，每年多花大約{a}的交通費。
zht..out.h: 幸福感 +1；通勤變長會有點累。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (renovations usually add less to a home’s value than they cost)

opts.do: spend('f_reno', .08 * base, 'trk.f_reno'); house.value += .07 * base; happy += 1; if (roll('f_reno') < .1) health -= 3

en..x: Your kitchen is tired and the cupboards are falling apart.

en..diy.h: Happiness +1. Adds nearly its cost to the home’s value. A small risk of hurting yourself.

zh..diy.h: 幸福感 +1。房子增值接近花费。有一点受伤的风险。

zht..x: 廚房舊了，櫃子也快散了。

zht..diy.h: 幸福感 +1。房子增值接近花費。有一點受傷的風險。

events.src: Rooftop solar usually pays for itself in 6–12 years (IEA, Renewables 2023); the figures used here are an ESTIMATE

en..x: A neighbour has put solar panels on the roof and hardly pays for electricity any more.

en..x: Your car is getting old. The dealer has a leasing offer on a new one.
en..lease.s: About {a} a year for four years; then you hand it back.

zh..x: 你的车开旧了。车行有新车租赁方案。

zht..x: 你的車開舊了。車行有新車租賃方案。
zht..lease.s: 四年裡每年大約{a}，到期還車。

opts.do: spend('f_car2', .15 * base, 'trk.f_car2'); T('f_car2run', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.f_car2run')}); rec('f_car2run', .03 * base, 10); happy += 2

en..x: School runs, two jobs and weekend clubs: one car is not enough any more.

en..one.s: Careful planning and the odd taxi.

zh..x: 接送孩子、两份工作、周末活动：一辆车不够用了。

zht..x: 接送孩子、兩份工作、週末活動：一台車不夠用了。

opts.do: putIn('f_cottage', .8 * base, {rate: .01}, 'trk.f_cottage'); T('f_cottageC', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.f_cottageC')}); rec('f_cottageC', .03 * base, 20); happy += 4

en..x: A little cottage by the sea, where you have spent many holidays, is for sale.
en..buy.s: {a}, plus about {b} a year in upkeep.
en..let: Buy it and rent it to holidaymakers
en..let.s: {a}; the rent roughly covers the upkeep.
en..no: Keep renting it for a week each summer

zh..x: 你度过很多假期的海边小屋要卖了。

zht..x: 你度過很多假期的海邊小屋要賣了。

opts.do: T('m_airbnb', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.m_airbnb')}); rec('m_airbnb', -.04 * base, 10); happy -= 1

en..x: The children’s rooms are empty. Visitors pay well for short stays in your area.
en..yes.h: Happiness −1: strangers in the house and a lot of laundry. Cities sometimes change the rules.

zh..x: 孩子的房间空了。你们这一带的短租游客出手很大方。
zh..yes.h: 幸福感 −1：家里有陌生人，还要洗很多床单。城市有时会改规定。

zht..x: 孩子的房間空了。你們這一帶的短租遊客出手很大方。
zht..yes.h: 幸福感 −1：家裡有陌生人，還要洗很多床單。城市有時會改規定。

en..x: The city now requires a licence for short lets, with inspections.
en..register.s: About {a} for the licence and safety checks.
en..ignore.h: About three in ten are caught and fined.
en.log.m_airbnb2: You were fined for letting rooms without a licence, and had to stop.

zh..x: 市政府规定短租要申请执照，还要接受检查。
zh..ignore.h: 大约三成会被抓到罚款。
zh.log.m_airbnb2: 你没执照出租被罚款，只好停了。

zht..x: 市政府規定短租要申請執照，還要接受檢查。
zht..ignore.h: 大約三成會被抓到罰款。
zht.log.m_airbnb2: 你沒執照出租被罰款，只好停了。

en..x: A builder suggests a walk-in shower and a downstairs bedroom, so you can stay in your home as you age.
en..later: Do it when you need it
en..later.h: Building work usually costs more when it is urgent.

zh..x: 装修师傅建议装无障碍淋浴间、把卧室搬到楼下，这样老了也能住。

zht..x: 裝修師傅建議裝無障礙淋浴間、把臥室搬到樓下，這樣老了也能住。

events.src: Heat pumps and insulation cut heating bills; payback is often 7–15 years (IEA, The Future of Heat Pumps 2022); figures used here are an ESTIMATE

opts.do: spend('m_pump', .1 * base, 'trk.m_pump'); T('m_heat', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.m_heat')}); rec('m_heat', -.012 * base, 25)
spend('m_insul', .03 * base, 'trk.m_insul'); T('m_heat', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.m_heat')}); rec('m_heat', -.006 * base, 25)

en..x: Your heating bills keep climbing. An engineer suggests a heat pump, or at least better insulation.

zh..x: 暖气费一直涨。技师建议装热泵，至少也该加强隔热。

zht..x: 暖氣費一直漲。技師建議裝熱泵，至少也該加強隔熱。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (renovating and selling a run-down house; costs often overrun)

later.m_fixer: const u = roll('m_fixer'), v = (u < .55 ? .7 : u < .85 ? .5 : .32) * base; cash += v; log(M(v > .5 * base ? 'log.m_fixerOk' : 'log.m_fixerNo', {a: MN(v)}), v > .5 * base ? 'good' : 'bad')

en..x: A run-down house is for sale cheap. Fixed up, it could sell for much more.
en..buy.s: About {a} for the house and the work.
en..buy.h: Happiness −2. About half make a good profit; the rest break even or lose. You find out in two years.
en.log.m_fixerOk: You sold the renovated house for {a}.
en.log.m_fixerNo: The renovation overran. You sold the house for only {a}.

zh..x: 有间破旧的房子便宜卖。翻新后能卖高很多。
zh..buy.h: 幸福感 −2。大约一半能赚不少，其余打平或亏钱。两年后揭晓。
zh.log.m_fixerNo: 翻新超支了，房子只卖了{a}。

zht..x: 有間破舊的房子便宜賣。翻新後能賣高很多。
zht..buy.h: 幸福感 −2。大約一半能賺不少，其餘打平或虧錢。兩年後揭曉。
zht.log.m_fixerNo: 翻新超支了，房子只賣了{a}。

opts.do: spend('m_nb', .04 * base, 'trk.m_nb'); happy -= 2; if (roll('m_neighbour') >= .6) house.value -= .04 * base

en..x: Your new neighbours have built a fence a metre onto your garden.
en..lawyer.h: Happiness −2. About six in ten win their case.
en..deal: Talk it through and split the difference
en..ignore.h: A boundary problem lowers what your home would sell for. Happiness −2.

zh..x: 新邻居把篱笆往你院子里多盖了一米。
zh..lawyer.h: 幸福感 −2。大约六成能打赢。
zh..ignore.h: 边界问题会让房子比较难卖。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 新鄰居把籬笆往你院子裡多蓋了一公尺。
zht..lawyer.h: 幸福感 −2。大約六成能打贏。
zht..ignore.h: 邊界問題會讓房子比較難賣。幸福感 −2。

en..x: {p} are finding it hard to manage on their own. You could build a small annexe in your garden for them.
en..build.h: Adds about two-thirds of its cost to your home’s value. Happiness +1.

zh..x: {p}越来越难独自生活。你可以在院子里给他们盖间小屋。
zh..build.h: 房子大约增值花费的三分之二。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: {p}越來越難獨自生活。你可以在院子裡幫他們蓋間小屋。
zht..build.h: 房子大約增值花費的三分之二。幸福感 +1。

opts.do: cash += .05 * base; const tq = T('l_carS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_carS')}); tq.v += .05 * base; car = null; T('l_taxi', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.l_taxi')}); rec('l_taxi', .02 * base, 20); happy -= 1

en..x: Your eyesight isn’t what it was, and you scraped the car on the gatepost last month.
en..sell.s: About {a} for it; taxis and buses cost about {b} a year.

zh..x: 你的视力大不如前，上个月还把车擦到门柱。
zh..sell.s: 车卖大约{a}；出租车和公交每年大约{b}。
zh..keep.h: 年纪大的驾驶比较容易出车祸。

zht..x: 你的視力大不如前，上個月還把車擦到門柱。
zht..sell.s: 車賣大約{a}；計程車和公車每年大約{b}。
zht..keep.h: 年紀大的駕駛比較容易出車禍。

opts.do: spend('l_lic', .005 * base, 'trk.l_lic'); if (roll('l_licence') < .3) { car = null; cash += .04 * base; happy -= 2 }
cash += .04 * base; const tq = T('l_carS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_carS')}); tq.v += .04 * base; car = null; happy -= 1

en..t: A driving test at your age
en..x: Your licence is up for renewal, and at your age that means a medical and a driving test.
en..test.h: About three in ten fail and have to give up driving.

zh..x: 你的驾照要换了，到了这个年纪要体检加路考。
zh..test.h: 大约三成会没过，只好不开车。

zht..x: 你的駕照要換了，到了這個年紀要體檢加路考。
zht..test.h: 大約三成會沒過，只好不開車。

en..x: The stairs to your bedroom have become hard work.
en..down.s: About {a} for a little building work.
en..none.h: Falls on stairs are common at your age.

zh..x: 上楼回卧室越来越吃力了。
zh..none.h: 你这个年纪在楼梯跌倒很常见。

zht..x: 上樓回臥室越來越吃力了。
zht..none.h: 你這個年紀在樓梯跌倒很常見。

en..x: Friends have retired to a warm country where their pension goes much further.
en..go.h: Happiness +3, far from family. Health care can be harder later.

zh..x: 朋友退休后搬去温暖的国家，退休金在那里很好用。
zh..go.h: 幸福感 +3，离家人远。以后就医可能比较麻烦。

zht..x: 朋友退休後搬去溫暖的國家，退休金在那裡很好用。
zht..go.h: 幸福感 +3，離家人遠。以後就醫可能比較麻煩。

en..x: Your health needs more care now, and the hospital is far away and speaks another language.
en..back.s: About {a} to move; living costs go back up.

zh..x: 你的身体需要更多照顾，但医院很远，语言也不通。
zh..back.s: 搬家大约{a}；生活费又变高了。

zht..x: 你的身體需要更多照顧，但醫院很遠，語言也不通。
zht..back.s: 搬家大約{a}；生活費又變高了。

en..x: You have always dreamed of touring the country in a camper van.
en.trk.l_rvR: A month in a rented camper van

zh..x: 你一直梦想开露营车环游全国。

zht..x: 你一直夢想開露營車環遊全國。

opts.do: cash += .12 * base; const tq = T('l_rvS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_rvS')}); tq.v += .12 * base
happy += 2; T('l_rvK', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.l_rvK')}); rec('l_rvK', .02 * base, 5)

en..t: The camper van, a few years on
en..x: You have had wonderful trips, but long drives are getting tiring.

zh..x: 你们玩得很开心，但长途开车越来越累了。

zht..x: 你們玩得很開心，但長途開車越來越累了。

en..x: Your children live far away. A small place near them has come up.
en..move.s: About {a} in moving costs and fees.
en..move.h: Happiness +2, closer to your children; you leave old friends.

zh..x: 孩子们住得很远。他们附近刚好有间小房子。
zh..move.h: 幸福感 +2，跟孩子更亲；但要离开老朋友。

zht..x: 孩子們住得很遠。他們附近剛好有間小房子。
zht..move.h: 幸福感 +2，跟孩子更親；但要離開老朋友。

opts.do: cash += .3 * base; const tq = T('l_garden', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.l_garden')}); tq.v += .3 * base; house.value -= .1 * base; happy -= 2

en..x: A builder offers to buy the far end of your garden to build a small house.
en..sell.h: Happiness −2: a building site, then neighbours. Your house is worth a little less.

zh..x: 有个建商想买你花园最里面那块地盖小房子。
zh..sell.h: 幸福感 −2：先是工地，然后有了邻居。你的房子会贬值一点。

zht..x: 有個建商想買你花園最裡面那塊地蓋小房子。
zht..sell.h: 幸福感 −2：先是工地，然後有了鄰居。你的房子會貶值一點。

en..x: Gutters, a leaking tap, a rotten window frame: jobs you used to do yourself.
en..cheap: The man who knocked on the door
en..cheap.h: Doorstep traders often do poor work that costs more to put right.
en..leave.h: The house loses a little value. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 排水沟、漏水的龙头、烂掉的窗框：以前都是你自己修的。
zh..cheap.h: 上门的工人常做得很差，之后要花更多钱补救。
zh..leave.h: 房子会贬值一点。幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 排水溝、漏水的水龍頭、爛掉的窗框：以前都是你自己修的。
zht..cheap.h: 上門的工人常做得很差，之後要花更多錢補救。
zht..leave.h: 房子會貶值一點。幸福感 −1。

en..x: Two old friends, both on their own now, suggest renting a house together.

zh..x: 两个老朋友现在也都是一个人，提议一起租房子住。

zht..x: 兩個老朋友現在也都是一個人，提議一起租房子住。
